shots.name: The Rod
shots.notes: A fishing rod handle with a button on top instead of a plunger. The same button fires torpedoes in video mode, though the flipper buttons do that job better.

shots.name: Long Cast Loop
shots.notes: The right looping shot and the spine of the game. Lit it pays a million or more and lights the next captive ball award; unlit, the upper gate stays shut and the ball drops into the LIE lanes instead.

shots.name: Upper Left Gate
shots.notes: A one-way gate the machine can open. It should only open right-to-left when Long Cast is lit or on a plunge. Stuck closed, you cannot advance the captive ball at all — that is an operator problem, not a you problem.

shots.name: L-I-E Lanes
shots.notes: Three top lanes. Either flipper button rotates the lit ones, so you should never collect a duplicate letter. Find which lane your machine feeds most out of the jets and keep that one unlit.

shots.name: Jet Bumpers (3)
shots.notes: Sit under the LIE lanes. Ordinarily filler, but Super Jets from the Fish Finder turns each one into 500K.

shots.name: Left Ramp
shots.notes: Lit at the start of the game. Shooting the right ramp or rolling the right return lane relights it. Backhandable on most machines, which is how you build ramp streaks.

shots.name: Right Ramp
shots.notes: Also lit to start. Lit ramp shots are what light the school of fish under the boat, six of them, for Monster Fish.

shots.name: The Boat
shots.notes: The inclined plastic boat in the middle. Three shots count as boat shots — left ramp, right ramp and the captive ball — and so does a U-turn off a weak ramp attempt.

shots.name: Captive Ball
shots.notes: Trapped inside the boat, and because the boat is inclined it takes a genuinely solid hit. Only a hit hard enough to reach the switch at the top counts for anything.

shots.name: Eject Hole
shots.notes: Usually reached up the left lane through the spinner, but a ball rattling out of the LIE lanes can drop in as well. Jackpots, the Fish Finder and video mode are all collected here.

shots.name: Spinner
shots.notes: On the left lane shot. Any award tied to it only needs the spinner to turn once, but it has to turn the right way — a ball coming back off a Long Cast does not count.

shots.name: Caster's Club
shots.notes: The hardest and most valuable shot on the machine. Balls do not stay here — they are kicked up a habitrail to the reel. Learn this shot before anything else.

shots.name: Caster's Club Drop Target
shots.notes: Guards the Caster's Club. It should only be up after you have collected a jackpot, or to block extra balls from entering during multiball. A machine that cannot retract it is close to unplayable for jackpots.

shots.name: Extra Ball Target
shots.notes: Just left of the Caster's Club, and one of the meanest extra ball shots ever built. The bottom right of the boat blocks it from the left flipper, so a right flipper backhand is the only realistic route.

shots.name: Left Stringer Target
shots.notes: Near the left slingshot, with a three-part fish in front of it. Each hit spots one segment. It is also a common drain shot, so do not force it.

shots.name: Right Stringer Target
shots.notes: The mirror of the left one. Only one side is live at a time — complete one and it goes dark until you finish the other.

shots.name: The Reel
shots.notes: Ball storage on the far left. It spins to take balls in or feed one back out around the top, arriving on a habitrail aimed at your left flipper.

shots.name: Left Return Lane
shots.notes: Always lights Long Cast, and rolling it again refreshes the timer without losing the current value. This is the single most useful lane in the game.

shots.name: Right Return Lane
shots.notes: Lights the Fish Finder at the eject hole and relights the left ramp. It starts the game lit and will not light during multiball or while video mode is waiting.

shots.name: Left Outlane
shots.notes: Carries the special once you light it, and stays lit for the rest of the game. Autocast will often give the ball straight back.

shots.name: Right Outlane
shots.notes: The special is lit on both outlanes at once, not one at a time.

shots.name: Left Flipper
shots.notes: Shoots the right ramp, the Long Cast and the Caster's Club. Balls fed from the reel land here.

shots.name: Right Flipper
shots.notes: Shoots the left ramp, the spinner lane and the eject hole, and backhands the extra ball target.

goals.title: Long Cast
goals.summary: The right loop, relit every time you roll the left return lane — that lane's lamp never goes out, but the Long Cast itself only stays lit for ten to fifteen seconds. Your first one pays a million and it climbs to five, and every Long Cast lights the next unclaimed value on the captive ball. This is the engine that drives everything else.
goals.reward: 1M rising to 5M, plus one captive ball value

steps.detail: Its light never goes out. Rolling it again while a Long Cast is about to expire refreshes the full timer and keeps your current value.

steps.action: Take the loop before it times out
steps.detail: You have somewhere around ten to fifteen seconds.

steps.action: Shoot it unlit to relight it
steps.detail: A right loop when Long Cast is dark simply turns it back on, which costs you nothing but a shot.

goals.title: The Captive Ball Ladder
goals.summary: Five awards stacked on the captive ball, lit from below by Long Casts. You can light every one before collecting any of them, but a hit only ever takes one award, so plan the order.
goals.reward: Hold Bonus 1M, Video Mode 2M, Rock the Boat 3M, Light Extra Ball 5M, Instant Multiball 10M

steps.detail: Each Long Cast lights the lowest value that is not already lit. The Fish Finder can do this too.

steps.action: Hit it hard enough to reach the switch
steps.detail: A soft hit moves the ball but scores nothing. Only the switch at the top counts.

steps.action: Collect Grab Yer Gear on top
steps.detail: Lit or not, every registered hit also pays a million times the highest award still lit, or 500K when nothing is.
Once the ladder is finished the captive ball is worth 5M a hit, rising 500K each time to a 10M ceiling.

goals.title: Spell L-I-E
goals.summary: Three top lanes that push the bonus multiplier to seven. Past 7x each completed LIE is worth 5M, then 10M, 15M and 20M from then on. Spelling it also relights the Fish Finder.
goals.reward: Bonus multiplier to 7x, then 5M-20M per LIE

steps.action: Rotate the lit lanes as the ball falls
steps.detail: Either flipper button moves them, so a duplicate letter is always avoidable.

steps.action: Set up the lane you feed most
steps.detail: Work out which lane your machine spits the ball into out of the jets and leave that one unlit.

steps.action: Use unlit Long Casts to fill lanes
steps.detail: With Long Cast dark the gate stays closed and the loop drops the ball straight into the lanes.

goals.title: Catch The Stringers
goals.summary: Two side targets, each with a three-part fish in front of it. Three hits completes a fish and lights one of four Stringers under the boat. Four Stringers starts Feeding Frenzy, and each fish is worth 250K at the end of every ball for the rest of the game.
goals.reward: 250K per fish at end of ball; four Stringers starts Feeding Frenzy

steps.detail: Only one target is live at a time and they alternate as you finish each fish.
Each finished fish also lights Stretch the Truth on the spinner for ten to fifteen seconds.
Both are frequent drain shots. Let the ball find them unless you are one fish from Feeding Frenzy.

goals.title: Stretch the Truth
goals.summary: Every completed Stringer lights the spinner briefly. Getting it scores one tale for each Stringer you already have, with each fish worth anywhere from nothing to five million. Four tales starts a thirty-second Rock the Boat.
goals.reward: 0-5M per fish, and Rock the Boat at four tales

steps.action: Complete a fish to light the spinner
steps.detail: The window is only ten to fifteen seconds, so have a route to the left lane in mind first.

steps.action: Get one turn on the spinner
steps.detail: One revolution is enough, but it has to be from the correct direction.
Every time you spell LIE the lowest spinner value goes dark, until only the 5x value remains and the spinner just cycles the survivors.

goals.title: Rock the Boat
goals.summary: Twenty seconds from the captive ball award, thirty from four tales, and every boat shot pays ten million. Three shots qualify — both ramps and the captive ball — and a U-turn counts as well.
goals.reward: 10M per boat shot

steps.detail: They are easier and far safer than the captive ball, and backhanding the same ramp repeatedly gets you into a rhythm quickly.
A shot that dies halfway and rolls back down the other side still pays as a boat shot.

steps.action: Only gamble on the captive ball with a reason
steps.detail: It is worth the drain risk when extra ball and multiball are both lit on it, because one hit can buy you both.

goals.title: Feeding Frenzy
goals.summary: Four purple fish and a rolling fifteen-second clock. Each fish you catch buys another fifteen seconds for the next, and the fourth is worth twenty million on its own — thirty-five million if you clear the set.
goals.reward: 5M, 5M, 5M then 20M — 35M for all four

steps.detail: The Long Cast fish and the spinner fish are the hard pair. Bank them while you still have clock to spare.
Any registered spin counts as that fish.

steps.action: Keep the ramp fish in reserve
steps.detail: You only need the boat ramp sensor, not the full ramp, so a U-turn collects both ramp fish at once.

steps.action: Buy time when the clock gets short
steps.detail: Cash an easy ramp fish to reset the fifteen seconds, then go back after the loop shots.

goals.title: Monster Fish
goals.summary: Six lit ramp shots light the school of fish under the boat and turn the spinner into a hurry-up. It starts at twenty million falling fast to a five million floor, and every one you land pushes the next ten million higher — up to fifty.
goals.reward: Up to 20M the first time, growing to a 50M ceiling

steps.detail: Those six ramps pay 500K, 1M, 1.5M, rising to 3M — by the time a Monster Fish lights, 10.5M is already banked.

steps.action: Finish the school from the correct flipper
steps.detail: Never shoot the sixth fish from the right flipper — that sends the ball back to the left flipper, and the spinner is a right flipper shot, so the transfer across burns value off the hurry-up.
There is a short delay before the countdown starts, so the full award really is reachable.
Miss it and the value stays where it stopped next time. Collect it at any price and the next one is worth ten million more.

goals.title: Play The Parity
goals.summary: The best-scoring habit on this machine. Count where you are in the school of six and make sure the last ramp comes off the left flipper, filling the gaps with shots from the opposite side.
goals.reward: Faster Monster Fish collections at higher value

steps.action: Check the count after every ramp
steps.detail: The machine makes a distinctive roar when the school completes, so listen as well as look.

steps.action: Fill an even count from the left flipper
steps.detail: Just shot an even fish from the right? Take a Long Cast or the Caster's Club from the left instead of another ramp.

steps.action: Fill an odd count from the right
steps.detail: Just shot an odd fish from the left? Go after the Fish Finder from the right flipper.

goals.title: Fish Finder
goals.summary: The right return lane lights the eject hole for fifteen to twenty seconds and pays a random award. The machine is unusually fair about it — keep hitting it and it will eventually hand you the extra ball no matter how well you are doing.
goals.reward: Random award including Instant Multiball, Super Jets or 1-5M

steps.detail: It starts the game lit and stays lit until you collect.

steps.action: Get to the hole in time
steps.detail: Awards are Light Extra Ball, Super Jets, Instant Multiball, an extra captive ball value, a bonus multiplier, or one to five million.
That is the only way back. Spelling LIE repeatedly does not bank extra Fish Finders.

goals.title: Video Mode
goals.summary: The second captive ball award. Twenty torpedoes, twenty seconds, and boats crossing at three distances. Always shoot the far row: it pays best and the extra ball only ever comes out on the back line.
goals.reward: 500K to 1.5M per ship, 10M at 15-19 hits, 20M for a perfect 20

steps.action: Take the second captive ball award
steps.detail: It cannot be stacked — shooting Light Video Mode again while it is already waiting simply wastes it.

steps.action: Start it at the eject hole
steps.detail: The eject hole is the only way in.
The rod button works, but the flippers work better and the game never tells you they are an option. Lead your targets slightly.

steps.action: Save a torpedo for the extra ball
steps.detail: Kill the back row quickly and the extra ball appears there. Miss it and, with enough time left, it can come back around once more.

goals.title: Multiball Jackpots
goals.summary: Everything in multiball is the same two-shot pattern: Caster's Club to light, eject hole inside fifteen seconds to score. Jackpots run twenty, thirty then forty million, and the tackle box shows which one you are on.

steps.detail: This is the shot to practise. Some machines can be backhanded from the right flipper, most cannot.
There is a visible timer on the display.
Completing a Stringer during multiball adds a million to the jackpot.
It should only be up after a jackpot, or to block a second ball entering. If it is stuck up, jackpots are close to impossible and the machine needs attention.

goals.title: Doubles Jackpot
goals.summary: With three balls in play the Caster's Club flashes for a doubled jackpot. Feeding it a second ball doubles the value and restarts the fifteen seconds — but if the clock runs out both balls come back at you and you start over.
goals.reward: Double the current jackpot

steps.detail: Only available with all three balls alive; the drop target blocks anything beyond that.
Time out and both balls are fired back into play with nothing scored.
If you lose the third ball first, one ball is kicked back and you are playing for a plain single jackpot.

goals.title: Super Jackpot
goals.summary: Take all three jackpots and the captive ball lights for a hundred million a hit, over and over, until multiball ends. Then it gets better: every completed sequence multiplies all the jackpots, and it climbs as far as six times.
goals.reward: 100M per captive ball hit, multiplied up to 6x on later sequences

steps.detail: Which jackpot you are on is remembered for the whole game, so you do not need them in one multiball.
A hundred million per registered hit for the rest of the multiball. If you light it but never hit it, it stays lit into the next multiball.

steps.action: Keep going after the first one
steps.detail: Finishing a full sequence doubles every jackpot including this one, and the multiplier keeps climbing to a ceiling of six.

goals.title: Fast Cast
goals.summary: Hit the Caster's Club immediately after a Long Cast or a ball launch and you score a Fast Cast. It starts at two million and grows a million each time, up to a ten million cap.
goals.reward: 2M rising to 10M

steps.detail: A launch works too, but Autocast returns do not count.

steps.action: Go straight into the Caster's Club
steps.detail: The drop target counts when it is supposed to be standing.

goals.title: Double Cross
goals.summary: In multiball, get a ball up each ramp before the first one reaches its return lane and the machine pays five million for the pair. Easy to stumble into and easy to repeat once you know it exists.
goals.reward: 5M

steps.detail: Timing, not accuracy, is what this is about.

steps.action: Send the second before the first returns
steps.detail: It has to be up the other ramp before the first hits its return lane.

goals.title: The U-Turn
goals.summary: A ramp shot that runs out of steam and comes back down the other side is worth a million, and the machine treats it as a real shot. It counts for Rock the Boat, and it collects both boat fish at once during Feeding Frenzy.
goals.reward: 1M, and it counts as a boat shot

steps.action: Do not curse a weak ramp
steps.detail: It pays a million as a U-turn.
Only the boat ramp sensor is needed for a Feeding Frenzy fish, so one U-turn spots both ramp fish.

goals.title: Autocast
goals.summary: The ball save, and it is quick — the machine will feed you the next ball before the one you lost has finished draining. It is also briefly active on a ball fed from the reel in a multiplayer game even when the light is off.
goals.reward: Ball returned, and a mini-multiball on a death save

steps.detail: This is the window for risky shots like the captive ball and the Stringers.
Save the ball you were about to lose and you now have two in play at once.

goals.title: The Extra Ball
goals.summary: Two routes to light it — the Fish Finder or the fourth captive ball award — and then the hardest part starts, because the target itself sits in the shadow of the boat.
goals.reward: Extra ball

steps.action: Light it from the Fish Finder
steps.detail: The machine is generous here and will hand it over eventually if you keep visiting.

steps.action: Or take the fourth captive ball award
steps.detail: Light Extra Ball sits fourth on the ladder, above Rock the Boat and below Instant Multiball.

steps.action: Backhand it from the right flipper
steps.detail: The boat blocks the angle from the left flipper. Some machines want a dead-on hit.

goals.title: Light The Special
goals.summary: Finish the whole captive ball ladder through Instant Multiball, then keep hitting the captive ball — usually four more times. Both outlanes light for special and stay lit the rest of the game. The catch is that it has to happen on that same ball.
goals.reward: Special on both outlanes for the rest of the game

steps.detail: Instant Multiball is the last award, so the special is only in reach after the ball that finishes the set.

steps.action: Keep going, about four more hits
steps.detail: Drain before you finish and you have to complete the next full set of captive ball awards to try again.
Once lit it stays lit on both outlanes for the rest of the game, so a drain finally pays for itself.

goals.title: Build The Bonus
goals.summary: Bonus caps at three million for a ball, but a 7x multiplier turns that into twenty-one million, and fish and tales are added on top of the multiplied figure rather than inside it.
goals.reward: Up to 21M plus 250K per fish and 500K per tale

steps.detail: The multiplier is worth more than the bonus itself.
Each fish caught pays 250K at the end of every ball for the rest of the game, and each tale pays 500K.

steps.action: Take Hold Bonus when it matters
steps.detail: The first captive ball award holds everything into the next ball, including whatever the LIE lanes were worth when you drained.

goals.title: What Not To Do In Multiball
goals.summary: Two habits cost more points on this machine than any missed shot: wasting an Instant Multiball, and forgetting that everything else keeps running while the balls are out.
goals.reward: Cleaner multiballs and better ramp value

steps.action: Do not cash Instant Multiball during multiball
steps.detail: It is a wasted award, and with two balls already locked you should always take the regular multiball first — Instant Multiball leaves you with no locks afterwards.
Ramps still light the Monster Fish during multiball. Listen for the roar.
The captive ball still collects whatever it is lit for, and the Long Cast still advances it.

achievements.title: Cast Long
achievements.desc: Roll the left return lane and land the Long Cast.

achievements.title: Found One
achievements.desc: Collect a Fish Finder award at the eject hole.

achievements.title: Seven Times
achievements.desc: Spell L-I-E enough times to reach a 7x bonus multiplier.

achievements.title: Came Back Around
achievements.desc: Score a U-turn off a weak ramp shot.

achievements.title: Rock The Boat
achievements.desc: Start Rock the Boat and take at least one ten-million boat shot.

achievements.title: Twenty Torpedoes
achievements.desc: Reach video mode from the captive ball ladder and play it out.

achievements.title: Fast Cast
achievements.desc: Follow a Long Cast straight into the Caster's Club.

achievements.title: Feeding Frenzy
achievements.desc: Catch all four purple fish for the full thirty-five million.

achievements.title: Monster Fish
achievements.desc: Light the school and collect a Monster Fish hurry-up.

achievements.title: Twenty For Twenty
achievements.desc: Hit every torpedo in video mode for the twenty-million bonus.

achievements.title: Super Jackpot
achievements.desc: Collect all three jackpots and cash the captive ball for a hundred million.

achievements.title: Lit For The Rest Of The Game
achievements.desc: Finish the captive ball ladder and keep hitting it to light the outlane special.

drills.title: Learn The Caster's Club
drills.text: This is the hardest and most valuable shot on the machine, so drill it before anything else. Check the drop target in front of it first — it should only be standing after a jackpot, and a machine that cannot retract it is not worth chasing jackpots on.

drills.title: The Two Shots The Boat Hides
drills.text: The captive ball sits inside an inclined boat, so only a hit hard enough to reach the top switch registers — a soft one just moves it. The extra ball target is blocked from the left flipper by the bottom of the same boat, so backhand it from the right.

drills.title: Left Lane Into Long Cast
drills.text: The left return lane always lights the Long Cast and its lamp never goes out, so roll it and take the loop before the ten to fifteen seconds run down. Roll the lane again when the timer is nearly up and you keep the value you have built instead of starting over.

drills.title: Count The School
drills.text: Keep track of where you are in the six ramps and make sure the last one comes off the left flipper, filling the gaps with Long Casts and Caster's Club shots instead of another ramp. Finish from the right and the ball has to transfer across before you can reach the spinner, and the hurry-up is falling the whole time.

drills.title: Club, Then Hole
drills.text: Multiball is the same two shots over and over: Caster's Club to light the jackpot, eject hole inside fifteen seconds to score it. Run the pair until you stop having to look at the display timer.

drills.title: Risk Only While Autocast Flashes
drills.text: Take the captive ball and the Stringer targets while the ball save is flashing, and go back to the ramps the moment it goes out. Both Stringers are frequent drain shots, and outside that window the ball will find them on its own.

actionButton.label: Rod Button
actionButton.location: on top of the fishing-rod handle where the plunger would normally be
actionButton.how: Fish Tales trades the spring plunger for a little fishing rod, and the button on top of the handle is what launches the ball. It keeps a job after that too: it is the fire control in video mode, which is the only place it matters once a ball is in play.

uses.what: One press sends the ball. Nothing to pull back and no plunge strength to judge, so there is no skill in it.
Each press fires a torpedo at the passing boats. Twenty torpedoes, twenty seconds.

uses.when: You want the extra ball in video mode
uses.what: Ignore the rod and fire with the flipper buttons instead. They aim better and the game never tells you they work.

uses.when: A skeleton fish drifts past the background
uses.what: Hammer the button about ten times for a joke award worth 10 points and a very good animation.

howItPlays.objective: Spin a bigger fishing yarn than the last guy on Williams' bass-boat table: keep the right-loop Long Cast lit, climb the captive-ball ladder, and stretch the truth for a fat bonus. The marquee payoff is a hundred-million Super Jackpot hammered over and over during multiball.
loop: Roll the left return lane to light the right loop, then take the Long Cast for a value that climbs from a million toward five and lights the next captive-ball award.
Bang the captive ball hard enough to trip its top switch and cash the lit rung -- Hold Bonus, Video Mode, Rock the Boat, Extra Ball, then Instant Multiball.
Spell L-I-E across the top lanes to push the bonus multiplier and relight the Fish Finder at the eject hole.
Light three jackpots at the Caster's Club, then finish the ladder and pound the lit captive ball for the Super Jackpot.

lights.name: Long Cast Loop
lights.lit: The right loop lights for a Long Cast whenever you roll the left return lane -- and that return-lane lamp itself never goes dark -- but the loop only holds its lit value for ten to fifteen seconds before it fades.
lights.then: Take the loop before it times out for a value that grows from one million toward five and lights the next unclaimed award on the captive ball. Re-roll the left return lane as the timer runs low to refresh it and keep the value you already built.

lights.name: Captive Ball Ladder
lights.lit: Every Long Cast lights the lowest award not yet showing on the boat's captive ball, a lit rung waits until you cash it, and you may leave all five glowing before collecting any of them.
lights.then: Strike it firmly, because only a blow that trips the top switch scores -- a soft shove shifts the ball for nothing -- and each solid hit banks a single award, so plan the order: Hold Bonus, Video Mode, Rock the Boat, Extra Ball, Instant Multiball. Finish the whole set and the captive ball itself is worth five million a hit, rising to a ten-million ceiling.

lights.name: L-I-E Top Lanes
lights.lit: A lit L, I, or E rollover at the top is a letter you still need, and a duplicate never has to be wasted because the trio can be shifted to meet the ball.

control.effect: either flipper tap walks the lit top rollovers sideways, letting you drop the letter you are missing under whichever lane the ball is diving into
control.when: as the ball spills down out of the jet bumpers toward the lanes

lights.then: Complete L-I-E to step the end-of-ball bonus multiplier toward seven, after which each spelling is worth five million climbing to twenty, and to relight the eject-hole Fish Finder. Learn which lane your jets feed the ball into most and leave that one dark so the word closes fast.

lights.name: Stringer Fish
lights.lit: Only one side target is live at a time, three hits on the lit one finishes its three-part fish and lights a Stringer under the boat, and a finished fish stays banked to pay 250K at the end of every remaining ball.
lights.then: Each finished fish also lights the spinner briefly for Stretch the Truth, where every earlier Stringer pays a tale worth anywhere up to five million. Bank all four Stringers to start Feeding Frenzy -- four purple fish on a rolling clock worth up to thirty-five million for the set.

lights.name: Ramp School
lights.lit: Both ramps are lit at the start of the game, each lit ramp shot drops one fish into the six-fish school beneath the boat, and a spent ramp relights off the right ramp or the right return lane.
lights.then: Fill the school of six to turn the spinner into a Monster Fish hurry-up that opens near twenty million and climbs ten million higher each time you cash one. Keep the last ramp on the left flipper so you can reach the spinner before the falling value bleeds away.

lights.name: Fish Finder Scoop
lights.lit: The right return lane arms the eject-hole Fish Finder for a stretch of fifteen to twenty seconds, and the lane glows that way from the opening ball.
lights.then: Reach the hole in time for a random gift -- Super Jets, Instant Multiball, one to five million, a spare captive-ball value, a bump to your bonus multiplier, or Light Extra Ball -- and the machine is generous enough that repeat trips eventually cough up the extra ball. Spelling L-I-E is the only way to relight it.

lights.name: Jackpot Shots
lights.lit: During multiball the Caster's Club lights for a jackpot while its drop target sits down; a target stuck standing makes jackpots nearly impossible and means the machine needs attention.
lights.then: Light the jackpot at the Caster's Club, then collect it at the eject hole inside about fifteen seconds, working the three values up through twenty, thirty and forty million. Bank all three and the captive ball lights for the Super Jackpot.

howItPlays.laneChangeNote: Tap either flipper button to walk the three lit top rollovers sideways as the ball tumbles out of the jets, sliding the letter you still need under the lane it is taking so no duplicate is collected. Closing L-I-E steps the bonus multiplier toward 7x -- then pays five million rising to twenty per spelling -- and relights the Fish Finder at the eject hole.

scoring.text: Light the Long Cast off the left return lane and start climbing the captive-ball ladder a rung at a time. Spell L-I-E early for a bonus multiplier that is worth far more than the bonus itself.

Finish the side Stringers into Feeding Frenzy, light the six-ramp school for a Monster Fish hurry-up, and take Rock the Boat's ten-million boat shots on the safer ramps. Visit the Fish Finder whenever it is lit, because it eventually hands over the extra ball.

Finish the captive-ball ladder through Instant Multiball, bank all three Caster's Club jackpots, then hammer the lit captive ball for a hundred million a hit -- the Super Jackpot, which multiplies up to six times on later sequences. Keep hitting the captive ball after the ladder is done and both outlanes light the special for the rest of the game.
